name: Manual call point plan symbol
summary: Fire alarm plan symbol for a manual call point that occupants operate to raise the alarm, placed at exits.
description: Manual call points, often break-glass or resettable push units, are drawn as a square with a filled or crossed inner square, or a circle with a dot, at their wall position. They are placed at storey exits and exits to open air so a person leaving can raise the alarm.
Mounting height and travel distance to the nearest call point are set by the fire code. The plan allows inspectors to check these quickly.
The symbol does not show whether the unit is resettable or break-glass, or whether it has a protective cover. The schedule states this.
distinction: A bell push or assistance call button looks similar on a plan; the call point belongs to the fire alarm system.
